reviews.title: Only limited response from CoinSnap when asking for higher review of a coin submitted. Disappointing
reviews.text: I am writing to express my disappointment with both the accuracy of your app and the lack of meaningful customer support I have received.  I have submitted multiple requests regarding a Chinese gold coin that was incorrectly identified by the app. Despite taking the time to report these errors, I have not received an adequate response or seen any effort to correct my collection. As a result, the collection in my account no longer reflects the coins I actually own, making the app unreliable for inventory and record-keeping.  The value of a coin identification app depends on accurate identifications and responsive customer support. Unfortunately, my experience has been the opposite. Repeatedly reporting the same issues without resolution has been frustrating and has caused me to lose confidence in your service.  Because of this experience, I am canceling my subscription and request that my account and any inaccurate collection data associated with it be closed or deleted.

reviews.title: False identification
reviews.text: I was hoping this app would identify all the change accumulating in my purse. I know nothing of evaluating change so I tried this app with high hopes . At first it seemed to be working great but then I accidentally took a pic of the same side of a coin twice. It actually gave me a value for the doubled head shot. So I experimented and took pics of different coins , pretending it was only one coin, it gave me a value. Then I took pic of the same coin over and over. I kept getting different values. Perhaps this app needs to be adjusted because you can’t have the same coin being .05 cents then worth $12 then worth $30. It even gave me a value when I put a dime and a penny as the same coin. ???? This makes no sense

reviews.title: Very good but missing some key upgrades
reviews.text:
I believe the app is well worth the yearly fee but what would make it MUCH better would be ability to organize the collection based on denominations and years. For example, I uploaded a lot of coins. I should be able to click a button to organize it the way I want (denomination/date order) so I can locate specific coins without having to scroll incessantly. This would and should be a huge and easy update. 

Also, the app gives approximate ‘value’ at the time of scan. That value and auto updated values should be next to the individual coins without having to tap into it. Again, another easy software update. 

Hopefully we’ll see these soon!

reviews.title: Not Ready for Prime Time
reviews.text: The app identifies common constitutional coins but does not have a high accuracy of grades or values. I used slabbed NGC and PCGS to test it and found it downgraded coins by a lot. MS69 to AU58 and MS 70 to MS 63 and still did not reflect values well. It also had a lot of issues with other Countries bullion identifications. The app did not assess market values either very well. MS Libertad 1oz-ers valued at melt $76…seriously…Yes I know what melt/spot is…But what is its value on the Market! I do believe with some backend adjustments it would be a lot better. If you do not have hundreds of coins…CoPilot actually goes into NGC to assess and will produce an excel if told too. Also, Google is a lot better with the marginal information values, grading and what it is, but it is cumbersome on the process. Overall not keeping it.

reviews.title: Subscription bait and switch
reviews.text: I signed up for a free one week subscription, and there was a very clear notice that said I would not be charged for a yearly subscription after the one week. There was another notice that said they would send me a reminder when the subscription ended and before I would be charged for the yearly subscription. This did not happen. No notification was sent and I was charged for the yearly subscription a day before the one week free subscription ended. Apple denied my refund. Now I am stuck with paying $50 for your subscription of an app that I tested a few times and found it to not work very accurately. Be aware that this app is not accurate and it’s results as it found a Canadian quarter I had and said it was a US quarter and many other mistakes. Also, this is a bit of a scam with the subscription free for a week and charging you before the week is up without any notifications that they claim they will send prior to charging you.
